== Biography ==
Janet Glasgow was born about 1840 at Kilmarnock, Ayrshire, Scotland, the youngest daughter of [[Glasgow-3051|John Glasgow]], a weaver and Chelsea Pensioner, and [[Gemmill-363|Janet Gemmill]].<ref>''1851 Scotland Census'', Parish Kilmarnock, Mitchells Land, household schedule 44, roll CSSCT1851_133, page 11 line 9, FamilySearch, accessed 23 Sep 2025, [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VBQJ-N4N ARK VBQJ N4N].</ref> She lived with her parents and siblings at Kilmarnock where the father worked at the loom and drew a military pension.

In youth Janet worked as a bonnet trimmer, a ribbon and lace finisher within the local textile trades at Kilmarnock.

On 7 April 1869 Janet married Robert Hunter Campbell at Kilmarnock, Ayrshire.<ref>''Scotland Marriages 1561 to 1910'', entry for Robert Hunter Campbell and Janet Glasgow, Kilmarnock, 7 Apr 1869, FamilySearch, accessed 23 Sep 2025, [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XT2C-MVQ ARK XT2C MVQ].</ref>

=== Residence and migration ===
* 1871 at Kilmarnock, Ayrshire, household of Robert and Janet Campbell.<ref>''Scotland Census 1871'', Kilmarnock, Ayrshire, FamilySearch, accessed 23 Sep 2025, [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VBR4-CF7 ARK VBR4 CF7].</ref>
* 1879 to 1881 at the Cockermouth registration district in Cumberland. The registration of John Glasgow Campbell in 1879 and Martha Campbell in 1881 confirms relocation from Scotland to England by this period.<ref>''England and Wales Birth Registration Index 1837 to 2008'', Cockermouth registration district, 1879 and 1881, FamilySearch, accessed 23 Sep 2025, [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:2XNH-343 ARK 2XNH 343], [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:2XV7-4QG ARK 2XV7 4QG].</ref>
* 1881 at Cross Canonby with Maryport, Cumberland. Robert worked as Locomotive Superintendent and Janet is present as Janet Campbell.<ref>''England and Wales Census 1881'', Cross Canonby with Maryport, Cumberland, FamilySearch, accessed 23 Sep 2025, [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:Q2WM-V245 ARK Q2WM V245].</ref>
* 1891 at Crosscanonby, Cumberland. Robert appears as widower which places Janet’s death between 1881 and 1891 within the Cockermouth registration district.<ref>''England and Wales Census 1891'', Crosscanonby, Cumberland, RG12 4309 page 15, FamilySearch, accessed 23 Sep 2025, [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:4JDR-4MM ARK 4JDR 4MM].</ref>
